editorial.intro: Explore Ilyushin aircraft clipart with Il 76 cargo transports, Il 62 airliners, Il 18 turboprops and Il 2 illustrations.
paragraphs: Compare the high wing and tall tail of an Il 76 transport with the long cabin of an Il 62 airliner. This Ilyushin aircraft clipart collection includes both profiles, plus Il 18 turboprops and drawings of the historic Il 2.

The {{artworkCount}} illustrations range from colored aircraft to ink outlines. Choose a distinct engine layout for an aviation history lesson, or build a personal comparison chart with separate spaces for passenger, cargo and military aircraft.

editorial.intro: Browse Pilatus aircraft clipart with PC 12 and Porter turboprops, PC 21 trainers and PC 24 business jet illustrations.
paragraphs: A PC 24 business jet and a Porter propeller aircraft make an interesting pair in this Pilatus aircraft clipart gallery. The collection also covers PC 12 turboprops and PC 21 trainers, so you can compare the shapes of several aircraft types.

From {{artworkCount}} illustrations, pick a clean profile for a classroom aircraft chart or a color scene for a personal flight notebook. Keep the propeller end and tail visible when you compare one aircraft with another.
